name: box
how: the box (PLAN-boot13.md 1.3): boot 12's reads (DMI's sys_vendor as ec2 yes or no and product_name, the flags lines' hypervisor and vmx, the CPUs, cores, sockets and nodes, /dev/kvm and kvm's parameters, steal over 5 s, the instance store by MODEL read only, the tools, KVM's debugfs, cpu0's frequency driver), BOX-idle (cpuidle's driver, governor, cpu0's states, the cmdline's idle tokens), numa_balancing and the nodes' CPUs, HS-orig's count, BOX-same (extra/box.txt)

name: cgnuma_C_1
how: each container's memory.numa_stat at m2 (anon and file by node), summed per service name, MiB (verify: cgroup-v2.rst)

name: cgpsi_C_1
how: each container's cgroup PSI (cpu.pressure and io.pressure some total, from /proc/<pid>/cgroup), summed by service name, m1 (m1b) to m2, in s; no container id kept

name: cpu_C_1
how: /proc/stat's cpu line on the host at m0, m1, m1b and m2: per window the busy share and busy CPUs (on the box's 192), iowait and steal

name: ds_C_1
how: /proc/diskstats over the load window, m1 (m1b) to m2: the root disk's and its partition's writes, flushes, ms writing and flushing, a second (verify: iostats.rst's columns)

name: env_C_1
how: host_env at m0, m1, m1b and m2 (PSI some avg10, avg60, total in s; loadavg; cpuinfo MHz; the guest's MHz); PSI as window figures (total_s deltas, m0 to m1 and m1 (m1b, or the rung's end in Fnw's first unit) to m2); the env sampler from the load's start to m2 (extra/env-C-1.jsonl: samples, PSI deltas, scaling_cur_freq's median, min and max, cpuidle's shares by state over ECPUS, the 1 min loadavg per CPU of the box); the load window's MHz from APERF and MPERF (base MHz x dAPERF / dMPERF per CPU: median, min, max)

name: idle_C_1
how: cpuidle on every CPU by state name (usage, time, above, below, rejected), m0 to m1 (idle), m1 to m1b (quiet) and m1 (m1b) to m2 (load): per state the usage and time deltas, the time share and entries a second, and per HOST_SET CPU [time share, entries a second, usage delta, time delta in us], summed for HOST_SET, below's and above's shares, the CPUs off HOST_SET by name, the IDLE_OFF states' combined share (extra/idle-C-1.json)

name: irq_C_1
how: /proc/interrupts over the load window, m1 (m1b) to m2: the root disk's nvme queue lines (nvme3q<n>) and RES, CAL, LOC a second, on HOST_SET and off it, and the CPUs that took the queue interrupts

name: numa_C_1
how: /proc/vmstat's numa_hint_faults numa_hint_faults_local numa_pages_migrated numa_pte_updates pgmigrate_success pgmigrate_fail over the idle, quiet and load windows: each change and its rate a second, the local share of the hint faults

name: percpu_C_1
how: /proc/stat's per-CPU lines, m1 (m1b) to m2: busy CPUs on HOST_SET and outside it, the busiest CPU and its share, busy CPUs per node

name: c_C_1
how: C's readback per container: docker inspect's CpusetCpus and NanoCpus and the pid's Cpus_allowed_list (extra/c-<n>.txt, names less the project), counted against the project's docker ps; the set HOST_SET (c32.yml)

name: pkg_C_1
how: MSR_CORE_C6_RESIDENCY on each HOST_SET CPU and MSR_PKG_C2 and C6 residency on CPU 0 (rdmsr 0x3FD, 0x60D, 0x3F9), as shares of the TSC over the load window, m1 (m1b) to m2 (verify: Intel SDM vol. 4 for this model)

name: quiet_C_1
how: laug projects (docker compose ls -a, laug and laug-*) and cells left (containers of a laug project) every 2 s, at most 300 s, then one sweep and 60 s more: after a compose unit's pool down (PLAN-boot10.md 4.4)

name: setting_C_1
how: the unit's host setting (PLAN-boot13.md 4.3, 4.6): its visit, position and session position, the SET's mark, hs_now at m0 and m2 against the setting's own read after its SET (a difference marks it moved), an upgrade running, counted apart and why

name: load_C_1
how: laug load -duration 5m -rate 20 -max-concurrent 50 -run-id lab13-C-1-load under taskset -c HOST_SET on a compose lease (C): verdict -json's verdict, exit, window and readings, the baseline's exit, the lease's seconds, the cpuset readback, gomaxprocs at m1 (steps/C-1-gmp.txt), the round and position or XA, the Fxa it follows (after_fx)
